title: Pathogen Profiles
description: Multi-pathogen profile definitions for concurrent simulation in Crusher-to-the-Bridge.

EffectRange.description: [lo, hi] bounds a phenotype mutation's effect is drawn from.

decay_rate_per_day.description: Daily fraction of viable food-reservoir mass lost.

spore_decay_rate_per_day.description: Daily fraction of environmental spore mass lost.

StrainEvolution.description: Optional heritable-strain parameters (variant surveillance, Paper 3). Absent block = no strain structure for this pathogen.

mutation_rate.description: Probability of a point mutation per transmission event.

phenotype_mutation_fraction.description: Fraction of mutations that alter phenotype rather than only the neutral label.

within_host_mutation_rate.description: Probability of a point mutation per infected-agent-epoch. Default 0 keeps the transmission-only model as the baseline.

within_host_mutation_rate_per_day.description: Daily-authored probability of a point mutation per infected-agent day.

recombination_rate.description: Probability of a recombination event per co-infected agent-epoch.

recombination_rate_per_day.description: Daily-authored probability of a recombination event per co-infected-agent day.

superinfection_susceptibility.description: Relative susceptibility of an already-infected host to a second strain of the same pathogen (0 = complete homotypic interference).

prior_genotype_distribution.description: Weights over genotypes for pre-existing immunity in baseline immune agents. Renormalized on load; keys must be declared genotypes.

cross_immunity.description: Matrix [prior_genotype][challenge_genotype] = protection in [0,1]. Keys must be declared genotypes.

effect_ranges.description: Ranges phenotype mutation effects are drawn from.

min_strain_fraction.description: Frequency floor below which strains are lumped into an unresolved bin, bounding state growth.

immune_waning.description: How protection from a resolved exposure ages, per pathogen. cross_immunity says how well a prior exposure matches a challenge; this says how fresh it is. All times are days of natural history, converted from epochs through the run's clock. Absent block = no refractory window and no waning, i.e. the matched cross_immunity value applies at any age.

refractory_days.description: Days after an exposure resolves during which refractory_protection applies regardless of genotype match. Sized so re-infection within a week-long voyage is rare; the waning term below is what a year-long deployment sees.

refractory_protection.description: Protection inside the refractory window, breached in proportion to a challenge strain's immune_escape. 1.0 = sterile against a non-escaping challenge.

half_life_days.description: Half-life of the genotype-matched protection after the refractory window. 0 = no waning.

residual_protection.description: Floor the decay approaches, capped at the matched protection itself.

notes.description: Provenance for these rates: literature anchor, or the fact that a value is a placeholder pending one.

SequencingAssay.description: Optional clinical amplicon typing assay (variant surveillance, Paper 3, spec §2.1). Absent block = this pathogen is not typed clinically. Read depth and the reporting floor are operator dials set at run time, not pathogen properties.

read_accuracy.description: Probability a read is assigned to the lineage it came from. Below 1 the assay can name the wrong genotype, not merely fail.

ct_threshold.description: Ct above which the specimen cannot be typed (shares the targeted-PCR standard curve).

cost_usd.description: Per-specimen financial cost; overrides the ledger default for clinical_strain_typing.

read_depth.description: Default reads per specimen for this assay; sweepable at run time.

min_reads_for_genotype.description: Reads a genotype must clear to be reported, which sets the mixture resolution.

Incubation.description: Incubation period as a distribution, conditioned on inoculum and host biology. Absent → the fixed symptom_onset_day path. Cross-field constraints JSON Schema cannot express (max_days > min_days, min_days below the median) are enforced by IncubationModel and reported by tools/sanity_checker.py.

distribution.description: Family the incubation period is drawn from.

median_days.description: Literature median incubation period at the reference dose in a neutral host.

dispersion.description: Geometric standard deviation (lognormal) or coefficient of variation (gamma). Lognormal requires > 1.

min_days.description: Lower truncation of the drawn period.

max_days.description: Upper truncation of the drawn period; must exceed min_days.

dose_reference_log10.description: log10 inoculum at which median_days applies.

dose_log10_shortening.description: Fractional reduction of the median per log10 of inoculum above the reference (and lengthening below it).

dose_floor.description: Smallest multiple of the median a large inoculum may produce (docs/ctb_incubation_spec.md dose_floor).

host_factors.description: Multipliers on the median per host axis; > 1 lengthens incubation. Absent (the shipped default) is the spec's recommendation: host frailty modifies severity strongly and incubation at most weakly, so these belong to a sensitivity arm rather than the main line.

notes.description: Provenance for the median, dispersion, and conditioning terms. Required: an unanchored incubation period silently sets detection timing for every result.

allOf.description: A lognormal dispersion is a geometric standard deviation, so 1 is a point mass and below 1 is inverted.

shedding_curve_log10.description: Day-by-day symptomatic shedding rate (log10 copies), indexed by days since symptom onset.

presymptomatic_shedding_days.description: Maximum days before virtual or realized symptom onset during which the host sheds at the first curve value. Absent means no presymptomatic shedding.

presymptomatic_shedding_notes.description: Literature provenance or rationale for presymptomatic_shedding_days.

dose_adjustment.description: Log10 shedding offset: shedding = 10^(curve[days_since_onset] - dose_adjustment) * shedding_multiplier. Campaigns calibrate infectivity via pathogen_overrides; not a dose-response α/β scaler.

shedding_variance_log10.description: σ of log-normal host shedding multiplier (0 = no variance)

transmission_route_weights.description: Relative pathway dose multipliers (typically sum to 1.0). Absent → all 1.0 (identity). Keys map to TransmissionCore pathways.

innate_nonsusceptible_fraction.description: Fraction of agents with zero susceptibility to this pathogen (e.g. FUT2 non-secretors for norovirus). Orthogonal to ship_graph.immune_fraction.

nonsusceptible_mechanism.description: Label for innate nonsusceptibility biology (e.g. FUT2_nonsecretor, none).

surface_decay_per_day.description: Daily fraction of viable surface-reservoir mass lost.

airborne_half_life_hours.description: Airborne decay half-life in hours, excluding ventilation.

initial_time_infected.description: Days post-infection when seeding initial_infected agents at introduction_epoch. Transmission-acquired infections always start at 0.

clinical_presentation.description: Bedside syndrome and time-dependent feature phases for diagnostic routing.
